svg.title: Tic-Tac: game 1, move 3
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays X and GitHub O, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts lock e5 and d2. After 2... Xh5, the Arbiter's move for @tannergolden: X takes the centre of the right board. It is GitHub's turn as O, in the centre board, due by 28 Nov. Boards won: X 0, O 0.
